Go again

shifting_tides.text_zh:
再动
在你的回合开始时，资源你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为蓝色，将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。否则，摧毁此牌。
shifting_tides.text_en:
Go again
At the start of your turn, pitch the top card of your deck. If it's blue, put this on the bottom of its owner's deck, otherwise destroy this.

submerge.text_zh: 作为使用此牌的额外费用，将你手牌中的一张牌放入你的牌库的从上往下第五张的位置。
submerge.text_en: As an additional cost to play this, put a card from your hand into your deck fifth from the top.

sunken_treasure.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，你可以将某个坟场中的一张牌翻为牌面朝下。若其为黄色，创造一个金币衍生物。
sunken_treasure.text_en: When this defends, you may turn a card in a graveyard face-down. If it's yellow, create a Gold token.

swiftwater_sloop.text_en: High Tide - If there are 2 or more blue cards in your pitch zone, this gets go again.

swindlers_grift.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张黄色牌。若如此做，抽一张牌并创造一个金币衍生物。
swindlers_grift.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard a yellow card. If you do, draw a card and create a Gold token.

将你坟场中的至多3张盟友牌翻为牌面朝下，然后创造等量的金币衍生物。

thievn_varmints.text_en: When this attacks, you may remove a gold counter from Treasure Island. If you do and you are a Thief, create a Gold token.

throw_caution_to_the_wind.text_zh: 展示你牌库顶的一张牌。本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中X点伤害，X为以此方式展示的牌的资源数值。
throw_caution_to_the_wind.text_en: Reveal the top card of your deck. The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent X of that damage, where X is the pitch value of the card revealed this way.
